research.topic: Psychologist vs Psychiatrist vs Counsellor: Who to See for What
verified: Anxiety that significantly impairs functioning may be treated with both medication and psychotherapy, whereas mild situational anxiety often improves with counseling alone.
Counselling using evidence‑based methods can lower stress scores in student populations, though the exact magnitude of reduction varies across studies.
Anxiety that interferes with functioning may need medication + therapy, while mild situational anxiety often responds to counselling.

research.hook: Ever wondered why you’re still feeling anxious after seeing a ‘doctor’ for your stress? The answer might be you’re talking to the wrong expert.
research.tip: Use the Help‑Match Checklist: assess if the issue needs medication (psychiatrist), therapy skills (psychologist), or short‑term support (counsellor) before booking.

data.title: Psychologist, Psychiatrist ya Counsellor? Kaun Hai Best for Anxiety
data.title_en: Psychologist, Psychiatrist or Counsellor? Who to See for Anxiety

scenes.text: Kya aap galat doctor ko pooch rahe ho anxiety?
scenes.text_en: Are you asking the wrong doctor about anxiety?
scenes.text_hi: क्या आप गलत डॉक्टर को पूछ रहे हो एंग्जायटी?

scenes.text: Exam stress ya job pressure se dil dhadak raha hai.
scenes.text_en: Exam stress or job pressure makes your heart race.
scenes.text_hi: एक्ज़ाम स्ट्रेस या जॉब प्रेशर से दिल धड़क रहा है।

scenes.text: Myth: Sirf psychologist hi aapki anxiety theek kar sakte hain.
scenes.text_en: Myth: Only a psychologist can fix your anxiety.
scenes.text_hi: मिथ: सिर्फ साइकॉलॉजिस्ट ही आपकी एंग्जायटी ठीक कर सकते हैं।

scenes.text: Reality: Severe anxiety often needs medication + therapy, psychiatrist ke paas.
scenes.text_en: Reality: Severe anxiety often needs medication plus therapy, see a psychiatrist.
scenes.text_hi: रियलिटी: गंभीर एंग्जायटी अक्सर मेडिकेशन + थेरेपी की जरूरत होती है, साइकियाट्रिस्ट के पास।

scenes.text: Myth: Counsellor sirf school bachchon ke liye hota hai.
scenes.text_en: Myth: Counsellors are only for school kids.
scenes.text_hi: मिथ: काउंसलर सिर्फ स्कूल बच्चों के लिए होता है।

scenes.text: Fact: Evidence‑based counselling bhi students ke stress ko kam karta hai.
scenes.text_en: Fact: Evidence‑based counselling also reduces student stress.
scenes.text_hi: फैक्ट: एविडेंस‑बेस्ड काउंसलिंग भी स्टूडेंट्स के स्ट्रेस को कम करता है।

scenes.text: Myth: Sab experts ek jaise hain, koi farq nahi.
scenes.text_en: Myth: All experts are the same, no difference.
scenes.text_hi: मिथ: सब एक्सपर्ट्स एक जैसे हैं, कोई फर्क नहीं।

scenes.text: Fact: Psychologist therapy deta, psychiatrist meds, counsellor short‑term support.
scenes.text_en: Fact: Psychologists give therapy, psychiatrists prescribe meds, counsellors offer short‑term support.
scenes.text_hi: फैक्ट: साइकॉलॉजिस्ट थेरेपी देता, साइकियाट्रिस्ट मेड्स, काउंसलर शॉर्ट‑टर्म सपोर्ट।

scenes.text: Ab aapka help‑match checklist: pehle decide medication?
scenes.text_en: Now your help‑match checklist: first decide medication?
scenes.text_hi: अब आपका हेल्प‑मैच चेकलिस्ट: पहले डिसाइड मेडिकेशन?

scenes.text: Agar nahi, therapy skills ke liye psychologist choose karo.
scenes.text_en: If not, choose a psychologist for therapy skills.
scenes.text_hi: अगर नहीं, थेरेपी स्किल्स के लिए साइकॉलॉजिस्ट चुनो।

scenes.text: Agar sirf short support chahiye, counsellor se milo.
scenes.text_en: If you only need short support, see a counsellor.
scenes.text_hi: अगर सिर्फ शॉर्ट सपोर्ट चाहिए, काउंसलर से मिलो।

scenes.text: Apni anxiety level samjho, sahi expert se milo, share karo!
scenes.text_en: Understand your anxiety level, meet the right expert, share it!
scenes.text_hi: अपनी एंग्जायटी लेवल समझो, सही एक्सपर्ट से मिलो, शेयर करो!

data.description: A quick guide to choosing between a psychologist, psychiatrist, or counsellor for anxiety. Learn myths, facts, and a simple checklist to get the right help.

fixes: Add a concrete Indian student scenario (e.g., IIT JEE prep stress) in scene 2.
Make the final CTA more actionable (e.g., 'Comment your anxiety level below and tag a friend').
Ensure each beat spans only 2-3 scenes by grouping related myths and facts together.
Trim any redundant phrasing to keep pacing tight.
